name: Greek Lemon Potatoes
desc: Potato wedges roasted in lemony garlic broth and olive oil until the liquid soaks in and the edges turn crisp.

source.title: Greek Lemon Potatoes
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 1/2 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into thick wedges
ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into thick wedges

ingredients.raw: 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth

steps: Whisk the broth, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Lay the potato wedges in a single layer in a large roasting pan or 9x13 inch baking dish and pour the liquid over them. Toss to coat.
Roast 20 min, then turn the potatoes and roast another 25 to 30 min, until most of the liquid has been absorbed.
Keep roasting, turning once, until the edges are browned and crisp, 15 to 20 min more.
Spoon the pan juices over the potatoes to serve.
tips: The creator's amounts are behind a paywall (serves 6, 1 hr 15 min). Quantities and roasting stages here follow RecipeTin Eats.
RecipeTin Eats moves the potatoes to a second tray for the final crisping and reduces the garlicky pan juices separately; roasting in one pan is simpler and a little less crisp.
